notes: output_file must name an entry of the document's output_files; GetOutputFileConfig returns nil otherwise and the config is rejected. A cross-document reference: expressible in the schema only as a string.
Exactly one: both set is an error, neither is an error. The if/then overlay can express this; (applicable, required) cannot.
prompt_template_name must match the key of a prompt_templates entry of the document. Cross-document, so the schema can only type it as a string.

Every output_mapping.column must be a column of the shared input/output channel spec. Needs the channel spec, so neither the schema nor the config validator can check it; the operator builder does, at DAG-build time. Recorded here rather than on OllamaSpec because output_channel is only reachable from the transformation.

The input and output channels must share the same channel spec: the operator augments the record in place. input_channel belongs to the enclosing PipeSpec, so this is a constraint no fragment-level check can see.
path is read only when source is response; with the other sources it is ignored rather than rejected. Candidate for applicable=no once reviewed.
schema_provider must name an entry of the document's schema_providers.
Only the first pipe of a step may read from a channel of type stage. Positional, so neither the schema nor a per-fragment check can express it.
